en.headline: Two accidents on Lion Rock Tunnel Road injure five and cause congestion
en.dek: Ten vehicles were involved in separate collisions on the Kowloon-bound carriageway near Union Hospital around midday, leaving five people with minor injuries.
body: Two traffic accidents involving a total of ten vehicles occurred within about half an hour on the Kowloon-bound lanes of Lion Rock Tunnel Road in Sha Tin on Saturday, injuring five people and causing significant congestion.

Police said the first collision, at about 11.42 a.m., involved two taxis and a private car near Union Hospital. A male taxi passenger sustained minor injuries. At about 12.09 p.m., a second incident at a similar location involved a medium goods vehicle, five private cars and a taxi, leaving four men with minor injuries to the neck or hands. All five casualties were taken to Prince of Wales Hospital.

The Transport Department said part of the Kowloon-bound lanes near the hospital remained closed while recovery work continued, restricting motorists to the remaining open lanes and leading to traffic queues on the approach to the tunnel. Police are investigating the causes of both accidents.

zh.headline: 獅子山隧道公路半小時兩宗車禍 涉十車五人傷
zh.dek: 沙田往九龍方向近仁安醫院先後發生兩宗交通意外，共涉及十輛車，五人輕傷送院，部分行車線封閉引致擠塞。
body: 沙田獅子山隧道公路往九龍方向周六中午前後半小時內發生兩宗交通意外，共涉及十輛車，五人輕傷。
警方表示，第一宗約上午十一時四十二分在近仁安醫院對開發生，涉及兩輛的士及一輛私家車，一名的士男乘客輕傷。約十二時零九分，同路段再有一宗涉及中型貨車、五輛私家車及一輛的士的串燒相撞，三名司機及一名乘客輕傷。五名傷者均送往威爾斯親王醫院治理。
運輸署宣布，因交通意外，獅子山隧道公路往九龍方向近仁安醫院的部分行車線仍然封閉，駕駛人士只可使用餘下行車線，上址交通擠塞。警方正調查兩宗意外原因。
